crossRefs.note: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

translations.web: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
translations.bsb: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.
translations.kjv: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully
translations.asv: I will sing unto Jehovah, Because he hath dealt bountifully with me. Psalm 14 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
